title: The Crystal Palace, Hyde Park 1851: west half
note: Everything the viewer shows is listed here. To add an exhibit, add an entry to "exhibits" and (optionally) a stop to "tour"; viewer code does not change.

record.label: Matches the record
record.help: agrees with the figures it was built from; a consistency check, not independent proof (ledger row 7)

inferred.label: Partly inferred or simplified
inferred.help: right size and place, but a level, height or detail is reasoned or left out

exhibit.label: Added exhibit
exhibit.help: built from published dimensions and one plate, tolerance 5-10%

exhibits.title: Osler crystal fountain
exhibits.placement: At the model origin, the centre of the nave and transept crossing (controls.json). controls.json says the crossing's position along the length should be confirmed against Plate I.

tour.title: Overview from the south-west
tour.body: All 37 built bays of the west half, 888 ft between the end column lines: three stepped tiers (408, 264 and 120 ft wide) under ridge-and-valley roofs. Nothing east of the transept's west face is built. Roofs are ghosted so the frame reads.

tour.title: The west end
tour.body: The west end and the tier-1 roof in front. The roofs are plain sheets with the ridge-and-valley profile. There is no end wall, no glazing and no entrance: this is a dimensioned frame, not a likeness.

tour.title: Inside the nave
tour.body: From the nave at gallery height, looking north-east and up: columns, connecting pieces and lattice girders. Every column spacing is 24 ft and the nave is 72 ft between its bounding rows; both are gated against the plates.

tour.title: From the gallery floor
tour.body: A strip of gallery floor, 22 ft 11 in above the ground, looking across the nave void. The railing along the void edge is inferred: no plate prints its height.

tour.title: The end of the nave void
tour.body: The cross railing that closes the nave void 72 ft from the west end (control D24), with the gallery floor beyond it.

tour.title: An avenue staircase
tour.body: Two ground flights rise to a landing, then upper flights climb to the galleries under a 48 x 24 ft cross gallery. Counts, widths and spacing match the record; the going and the handrail height are inferred from Plate XV.

tour.title: The stair wells from the gallery
tour.body: Looking north over the cross gallery: the two 8 x 16 ft well holes and the landing. Hole positions were read off Plate II to about 1 ft.

tour.title: Under the gallery
tour.body: Column heads and connecting pieces, lattice girders, and the underside of the gallery floor. Connecting pieces match the record in length and position; flanges and snugs are simplified.

tour.title: Down the nave to the crossing
tour.body: The frame stops 36 ft short of the crossing. The transept, its vault and everything east are not built. What stands at the crossing here is the one thing added to the model: the Osler crystal fountain, loaded from its own package through this manifest.

tour.title: Osler crystal fountain, 1851
tour.body: F. & C. Osler's cut-crystal fountain: 27 ft (8.23 m) from waterline to spout on a 24 ft basin. Heights are read from one plate (about 5% per level, 10% per diameter); the basin diameter is adopted from the building's 24 ft module. The water plume is not modelled. Hyde Park 1851 only.
